system.description:
Even the beasts and birds recognize the heroes of the dawn. This Charm keeps natural animals from attacking the character unless they are provoked or driven by unusual pain or fear. It allows the Exalt to communicate with natural animals--with sounds and gestures--as if they shared a common language.

Animals have limited capacity for comprehension, and the Exalt cannot convince an animal to adopt a belief or plan that it cannot understand. Characters can activate Friendship with Animals Approach when inactive (see p. 143).
